description: This Python source file implements an observer class for logging activities related to a Large Language Model (LLM) within the Pipecat framework. It captures and logs various frame types representing different stages and events in LLM processing, such as response start/end, generated text, function calls, messages, and context frames.

classes.name: LLMLogObserver
classes.description: An observer class that logs activities related to LLM frames during processing.

methods.name: on_push_frame(self, data: FramePushed)
methods.description: Asynchronous method that handles the event when a frame is pushed, logging details depending on the frame type.
